extractor: read directly from the official INZ page listed in source_roles
policy: Every entry quotes the official page it was read from. source_excerpt is verbatim government wording, lowercased by the normalizer. Nothing here is paraphrased into a requirement, and nothing is included that the page did not state.
not_extracted: The list of approved exchange schemes and approved education providers. INZ links these rather than stating them.
The student fund requirements (how much money counts as enough). INZ links a dedicated page that is not a registered source.
Form INZ 1014, the Financial Undertaking for a Student. Linked as a PDF from this page; the form itself is not registered as a source.
The precise age and school-year rules governing permission to work, which INZ splits across a linked section.
The fee paying student visa, which INZ names in prose here but does not link resolvably. It remains unregistered.

requirements.label: Study abroad programmes are NOT approved exchange schemes
requirements.description: Routing information rather than a hurdle: INZ names the correct alternative. Recorded because applying on the wrong student visa is the most expensive mistake available here.
requirements.source_excerpt: study abroad programmes are not approved exchange schemes. students planning to study with a study abroad programme should apply for a fee paying student visa .
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Study Abroad programmes are not approved exchange schemes. Students planning to study with a Study Abroad programme should apply for a Fee Paying Student Visa.

requirements.label: Evidence of an offer of place, or a letter from your exchange programme organisation
requirements.description: INZ's own sentence breaks at 'from an' where a link interrupts it; the excerpt preserves what is served.
requirements.source_excerpt: if you are attending a school-to-school or tertiary exchange programme, you need to provide evidence of an offer of place from an — this should state you are an exchange student. if you are coming to new zealand with an exchange programme organisation (epo), you need to provide a letter from your epo explaining that you are an exchange student.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: If you are attending a school-to-school or tertiary exchange programme, you need to provide evidence of an offer of place from an — this should state you are an exchange student. If you are coming to New Zealand with an exchange programme organisation (EPO), you need to provide a letter from your EPO explaining that you are an exchange student.

requirements.label: Be outside New Zealand when you apply
requirements.description: INZ adds that a visa can be granted from inside New Zealand only in very special circumstances, and that the applicant must explain why they arrived without a student visa.
